MERGE INTO MRO_PO_IPGO A USING ( SELECT $BUYER$ AS BUYER, $GR_NO$ AS GR_NO, $GR_SEQ$ AS GR_SEQ FROM DUAL ) B ON ( 1=1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.GR_NO = B.GR_NO AND B.GR_SEQ = B.GR_SEQ ) WHEN MATCHED TEHN UPDATE SET PO_REQ_NO = $PO_REQ_NO$ GD_CD_MRO = $GD_CD_MRO$ IP_DT = $IP_DT$ STATUS = $STATUS$ GD_CD = $GD_CD$ DANGA = $DANGA$ IP_QTY = $IP_QTY$ BUYER = $BUYER$ GR_NO = $GR_NO$ GR_SEQ = $GR_SEQ$
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT INTO MRO_PO_IPGO ( PO_REQ_NO, GD_CD_MRO, IP_DT, STATUS, GD_CD, DANGA, IP_QTY, BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ ) VALUES ( $PO_REQ_NO$, $GD_CD_MRO$, $IP_DT$, $STATUS$, $GD_CD$, $DANGA$, $IP_QTY$, $BUYER$, $GR_NO$, $GR_SEQ$ )
